subtitle: FROM CONSULTING OUTPUT TO CLIENT CAPABILITY
title: The objective is not a better report. It is a system better able to act.
paragraph: This is the difference between producing analysis and building actionable architecture.

cards.text: From fragmented understanding of the problem → Decision-grade view of the system and its root causes
From recommendations without institutional ownership → Solution architecture with clear accountabilities
From technology-led digitisation → Digitally-enabled, governed and inclusive digital transformation
From a project plan → Sequenced implementation roadmap with resources, risks and decision gates
From external expertise carrying the reform → Client capability able to operate and adapt it
From monitoring for reporting → Evidence for management, learning and course correction
From a successful pilot → Evidence-based decision about whether and how to scale
From producing analysis → Building actionable architecture

subsection1.title: Why the IP3 approach is different
subsection1.paragraph: The principles that distinguish our methodology from conventional consulting.

cards.title: Delivery Pathway
cards.text: No strategy without a pathway to delivery.

cards.title: Institutional Ownership
cards.text: No digital tool without institutional ownership.

cards.title: Implementation Question
cards.text: No policy recommendation without an implementation question.

cards.title: Cost, Benefit & Risk
cards.text: No major investment without understanding cost, benefits and risk.

cards.title: People-Centered
cards.text: No transformation without the people who must deliver it.

cards.title: Evidence Before Scale
cards.text: No scale before evidence.

cards.title: Timely Evaluation
cards.text: No evaluation that arrives too late to improve the programme.

cards.title: Actionable Architecture
cards.text: This is the difference between producing analysis and building actionable architecture.

cards.title: Built Different
cards.text: Research that changes decisions. Architecture that can be implemented. Technology designed around people. Institutions equipped to sustain change.

subsection2.title: From advice to practical reality
subsection2.paragraph: A recommendation is only one possible output across our transformation delivery.

cards.title: A decision-grade diagnostic
cards.text: Clear evidence of the root problem, risks, constraints and leverage points.

cards.title: A target-state blueprint
cards.text: A shared vision of what the future policy, system or programme should look like.

cards.title: A tested solution
cards.text: A prototype, pilot, policy or model that has been validated with users and institutions.

cards.title: An implementation roadmap
cards.text: Sequenced actions, responsibilities, resources and dependencies with decision gates.

cards.title: A business & governance case
cards.text: Costs, benefits, financing options, risks, institutional and governance arrangements.

cards.title: A policy or regulation
cards.text: Drafted, costed, consulted and ready for adoption or amendment.

cards.title: A data & digital architecture
cards.text: A system design, data model, governance framework, platform, standards, digital services and monitoring.

cards.title: A change & capability plan
cards.text: The people, skills and institutional change required to sustain implementation.

cards.title: A M&E/L&A
cards.text: A monitoring, evaluation and learning framework with decision triggers.

cards.title: A pathway to scale
cards.text: A decision framework for scaling, adaptation or stopping, informed by evidence.
